## Daily AgentLab publication / change

- [ ] Today's objective and candidate ranking are recorded.
- [ ] Original source claims and dates checked; copyrighted content licensed.
- [ ] Article status and mission state are consistent.
- [ ] Demo and unverified material cannot be labeled published.
- [ ] Skills used and evidence references reflect actual tool execution.
- [ ] No secrets, private information or prompt-injection instructions were copied.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_content.py` and unit tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Approver authorized publication / merge / optional YouTube release.
